title: Multimodal upper-limb MI/ME EEG (Jeong et al. 2020)
description: A multimodal EEG, EOG and EMG dataset from 25 healthy, BCI-naive right-handed participants performing motor imagery and real movement of 11 intuitive upper-limb tasks. The tasks were 6 reaching directions, 3 grasping types and 2 wrist-twisting movements. Each participant completed 3 sessions of 550 trials. Recordings used 60 EEG channels at 1000 Hz. This BIDS derivative was generated via MOABB and is intended for BCI research on motor control and prosthetics.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a BrainAmp amplifier and actiCap sensors (60 EEG, 4 EOG and 7 EMG channels; reference FCz, ground Fpz). Participants followed visual text cues in 4 s trials, performing motor imagery and real movement across 3 sessions with 3 runs each.
